<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Sikkim leadership reaffirms support for PM Modi:</strong> The Sikkim cabinet, led by Chief Minister Tamang, formally commended Prime Minister Modi for his 25 years of public service and reaffirmed the state&#x27;s commitment to its partnership with the Union government.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Central employees demand DA hike:</strong> The All India Defence Employees Federation (AIDEF) has formally urged the Cabinet Secretary and the Finance Ministry to expedite the announcement of a Dearness Allowance (DA) hike for central government employees.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
